_what: Hostnames whose referrals mean an AI answer engine sent a person here. Matched on the referrer HOSTNAME only -- never the full URL, which on some engines carries the user's question text.
_why: The portfolio can measure whether a page is cited (Bing Webmaster AI Performance) but not whether a citation was ever clicked. Clarity is installed on all three publications and supports custom tags, so classifying the referrer at page load turns arrivals into a filterable dimension with no new infrastructure and no new account.
_privacy: Hostname only. No query strings, no paths from the referring engine, no user identifiers. The landing path on our own site is recorded because it is our own URL.
_note_on_bing: www.bing.com is ambiguous -- a Copilot answer and an ordinary Bing result can both refer from it. It is tagged bing-or-copilot rather than being counted as an AI arrival, so it never inflates the AI number.
